mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, payload, failure_count, next_retry_at, last_error, last_retry_at, abandoned, created_at FROM reporting_event_dead_letter WHERE abandoned = FALSE AND next_retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE reporting_event_dead_letter SET failure_count = failure_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, last_retry_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
